description: Organization has not conducted a comprehensive risk assessment to identify and evaluate risks to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets and systems. Risk assessments must systematically identify threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood, and potential impacts to enable informed risk management decisions.
applicability: This signal applies to: Healthcare organizations subject to HIPAA requirements Organizations handling sensitive health information Entities subject to HITRUST CSF certification Cloud service providers in healthcare sector Business associates and covered entities Organizations with regulated information assets

metadata.detection_notes: Detection of this signal typically involves: Review of documented risk assessment procedures and methodologies Examination of risk registers and assessment reports Verification of assessment scope covering all information assets Analysis of threat and vulnerability identification processes Assessment of risk evaluation criteria and rating scales Validation of stakeholder involvement in risk assessment activities The presence of this signal indicates that the organization may be operating without understanding its risk exposure, potentially leading to inadequate security controls and compliance violations.
